The next into main pull request has ci green and the deploy for its merge commit succeeds
benchbox.dev home page and /docs/README.html show the new version
docs/benchmarks/support-status.md on main states the catalog counts for tpcds_obt, write_primitives and transaction_primitives, and docs:check passes against the new pin
The `docs-release-pending` issue, if open, is closed
Any step of the AGENTS.md procedure that did not work as written is corrected in AGENTS.md
context: Blocked on core publishing a release newer than v0.5.0; the nightly docs-release-pending issue announces it. Guardrails: owner decides when to publish a release in the docs; if the tag's commit has no certified bundle, stop and report rather than using --from on an unverified directory. Open question to settle during this run: nothing closes the docs-release-pending issue automatically.
description:
Problem: v0.5.0 was pinned with `--from` after verification by an older verifier, because the current verifier rejects that bundle. The default path of `npm run docs:pin -- vX.Y.Z` (child bundle-fetch with full verification, then the pin swap) has only been exercised up to the expected verification failure and through an injected fetch in tests. Outcome: the first release after v0.5.0 is pinned by the default path, and the release procedure in AGENTS.md is proven end to end.

At the next published core release: run `npm run docs:pin -- <tag>` on next by pull request, open the next into main pull request, merge on green ci, then merge main into next.
